title: Specialist, Network Planning Engineer (IP Network Engineer)

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Network Planning Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Minimum of 2 years' experience working in the [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Capable of following detailed instructions and completing assigned tasks on-schedule.
Able to work with minimal direct supervision.
Acute attention to detail and thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies.
Strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Preferred Requirements
3 Or more years' experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits, specifically with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.
Experience with [Product name masked].
MEF-CECP certification.
Works well in a dynamic team environment.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0040.intro: We are looking for a Network Planning Engineer to join our team. The selected candidate will work on multiple programs and initiatives as the primary contractor, supporting the management and implementation of IP network solutions. This role involves collaborating with internal and external teams, working independently on projects from start to finish, developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and completing full implementation and documentation. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of IP network design and transport technologies.
cond_0040.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0040.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Minimum of 2 years' experience working in the [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Capable of following detailed instructions and completing assigned tasks on-schedule.
Able to work with minimal direct supervision.
Acute attention to detail and thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies.
Strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Preferred Requirements
3 Or more years' experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits, specifically with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.
Experience with [Product name masked].
MEF-CECP certification.

cond_0101.intro: We are looking for a Specialist, Network Planning Engineer (IP Network Engineer) to join our team.
cond_0101.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0101.requirements:
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum 4 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant field with a Bachelor's degree, or minimum 2 years with a Graduate degree. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Minimum 2 years of proven expertise working in [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Advanced knowledge of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Exceptional attention to detail and strong command of all circuit types and transport technologies.
Ability to follow detailed instructions and complete assigned tasks on schedule with minimal direct supervision.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits, specifically Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.
Deep knowledge of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types, as well as solid understanding of existing processes and procedures associated with provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Advanced knowledge of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Expertise in Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Proficiency in [Product name masked] preferred.
MEF-CECP certification preferred.

cond_0157.intro: [Company name masked] is seeking a motivated individual looking for an exciting opportunity to join the team as a Network Engineer to support innovative network solutions. The selected candidate will be working on multiple programs and initiatives for [Company name masked] as the primary contractor. As a Network Engineer, supporting the management and implementation of IP network solutions. The selected candidate will collaborate with internal and external teams. Work independently on projects from start to finish, including developing network designs based upon user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and full implementation follow-through and documentation of requirements. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of IP network design and circuit provisioning.
cond_0157.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0157.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Possess a minimum of 2 years' experience working in the [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Have a thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Capable of following detailed instructions and completing assigned tasks on-schedule.
Work with minimal direct supervision.
Have acute attention to detail and a thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies.
Prefer 3 or more years' experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits. Specifically, with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.
Work well in a dynamic team environment.
Possess a strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Have a thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Experience with [Product name masked] preferred.
MEF-CECP certification preferred.

You will regularly collaborate with internal and external teams, and stay in close contact with stakeholders throughout projects — from developing network designs based on user requirements, to creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and completing full implementation and documentation.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs
Stay in regular contact with Carrier HUBs teams to ensure circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets, and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and actively coordinate with [Company name masked] field technicians on the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.)
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer
Interface directly with internal and external customers, explain technical details clearly, and provide assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits
Speak up with recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience; or a Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience; or in lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience
Minimum of 2 years' experience working in the [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages
Thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures
Thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures
Strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types, as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures for provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types
Able to follow detailed instructions and complete assigned tasks on schedule
Able to work with minimal direct supervision
Acute attention to detail and thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies
Comfortable working directly with internal and external customers to clarify requirements and walk them through technical issues
Able to work well in a dynamic team environment
Preferred Requirements
3 Or more years' experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits, specifically with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart
Experience with [Product name masked]
MEF-CECP certification

cond_0275.intro: We are looking for a Network Planning Engineer to join our team. The selected candidate will work on multiple programs and initiatives as the primary contractor, supporting the management and implementation of IP network solutions. This role involves collaborating with internal and external teams, working independently on projects from start to finish, developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and completing full implementation and documentation. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with IP network provisioning and circuit design work.
cond_0275.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.

cond_0282.intro: We are looking for a Specialist, Network Planning Engineer (IP Network Engineer) to join our team.
cond_0282.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0282.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with around 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate degree with around 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, around 8 years of prior related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Around 2 years of experience working in [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Familiarity with NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Able to follow detailed instructions and complete assigned tasks on schedule.
Able to work with minimal direct supervision.
Attention to detail and working knowledge of circuit types and transport technologies.
Experience in the range of 3 or more years working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits is a plus, particularly with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.
Comfortable working in a dynamic team environment.
Background in Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types, as well as some familiarity with processes and procedures associated with provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Familiarity with trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Experience with [Product name masked] is a plus.
MEF-CECP certification preferred, or willingness to obtain.

Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0289.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Minimum of 2 years' experience working in the [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Capable of following detailed instructions and completing assigned tasks on-schedule.
Able to work with minimal direct supervision.
Acute attention to detail and thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies.
Strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.

3 Or more years' experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits, specifically with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.

Work includes developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and maintaining full documentation of requirements.
cond_0322.responsibilities:
Work with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs.
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets, and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs.
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and provide direction to [Company name masked] field technicians on the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment, and circuits.
Coordinate with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes, and/or disconnects.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned in accordance with circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Provide technical assistance to internal and external customers on service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor optical network alarms, investigate root causes, and identify corrective actions to minimize disruption to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in collecting data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0322.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Possess a minimum of 2 years' experience working in the [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Have a thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Capable of following detailed instructions and completing assigned tasks on-schedule.
Able to work with minimal direct supervision.
Have acute attention to detail and a thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies.
3 Or more years' experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits preferred. Specifically, with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.
Able to work effectively in a team environment.
Possess a strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Have a thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Experience with [Product name masked] preferred.
MEF-CECP certification preferred.
cond_0322.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.
cond_0322.workplace_support: We aim to support employees across different life and career stages through development resources, workplace flexibility, and inclusive benefits that make it easier to grow, contribute, and stay well.

cond_0385.intro: We are looking for a Network Planning Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked], supporting IP network solutions across multiple programs and initiatives. In this role, you will work on network designs based on user requirements, create network diagrams using Visio, configure network equipment, and carry implementation through to documentation and completion.
cond_0385.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs.
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets, and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs.
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Coordinate with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes, and/or disconnects.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned in accordance with circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface with internal and external customers to provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor optical network alarms, investigate root causes, and identify corrective actions to minimize disruption to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in collecting data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0385.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience; Graduate degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience; or, in lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Minimum 2 years of experience working in [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV, and OC3-OC192 circuit types, as well as familiarity with provisioning and acceptance testing processes for these circuit types.
Able to follow detailed instructions and complete assigned tasks on schedule.
Able to work with minimal direct supervision.
Acute attention to detail and thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Preferred Requirements
3 Or more years of experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits, specifically Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454, and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.

MEF-CECP certification.

cond_0393.intro: We are looking for a Network Planning Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work across multiple programs and initiatives as part of the primary contractor team, supporting the management and implementation of IP network solutions. A regular part of the work involves staying in contact with internal and external teams, and you will handle projects from start to finish — developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and completing full implementation and documentation.
cond_0393.responsibilities:
Work directly and regularly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs.
Stay in close contact with teams to ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets, and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs.
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and actively direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly and regularly with internal and external customers, providing technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing, including walking customers through issues and handling questions.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Speak up with recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and actively provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.

You will take full ownership of projects from start to finish — developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and driving implementation and documentation through to completion.
cond_0539.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs.
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs.
Lead scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Execute [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and deliver technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and determine the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Drive recommendations for improving processes and procedures and take ownership of the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Lead scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Direct the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Execute test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0539.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Possess a minimum of 2 years' experience working in the [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Have a thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Capable of following detailed instructions and completing assigned tasks on-schedule.
Work with minimal direct supervision.
Have acute attention to detail and a thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies.
Prefer 3 or more years' experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits. Specifically, with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.
Work well in a dynamic team environment.
Possess a strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Have a thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Experience with [Product name masked] preferred.
MEF-CECP certification preferred.

This role involves collaborating with internal and external teams, working independently on projects from start to finish, developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and completing full implementation and documentation. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with IP network provisioning and circuit design work.
cond_0581.responsibilities:
Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs
Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design ([Product name masked]) and operations ([Product name masked], etc.) toolsets and ensure [Product name masked] design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs
Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct [Company name masked] field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment and circuits.
Work directly with Telco Carrier and [Company name masked] field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
Follow [Product name masked] workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes and/or disconnects as needed.
Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g. RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
cond_0581.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
Minimum of 2 years' experience working in the [Product name masked] troubleshooting and restoring network outages.
Thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures.
Capable of following detailed instructions and completing assigned tasks on-schedule.
Able to work with minimal direct supervision.
Acute attention to detail and thorough familiarity with all circuit types and transport technologies.
Strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types.
Thorough understanding of trouble ticket, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures.
Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart.
Able to work well in a dynamic team environment.
Preferred Requirements
3 Or more years' experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits, specifically with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms.
Experience with [Product name masked].
MEF-CECP certification.
